analysis_unit: One orientation-specific pre-common checkpoint row whose common update was safe and which carries the two subsequent clone responses (y1,y2). Clone responses are never expanded into independent rows.
claim_boundary: Descriptive, post-reveal, zero-new-sample, model- and order-dependent predictive allocation at two fixed checkpoints. Cross-fitting limits in-sample prediction bias but does not establish causal mediation, full-state sufficiency, scaled Markov closure, a continuum memory field, or a scale exponent.

degeneracy_audit.cooperative_label_boundary: The two cooperative coordinates are checkpoint local-multicontact proxies, not the exact two-step cooperative pair count.
excluded_observed_degeneracy: H2_direction_mixed is nonzero in only about 1.2%-1.7% of safe rows and is retained only in the support audit
essential_carriers>1 occurs in only about 0.14%-0.16% of safe rows
core_vertices and core_edges are near-collinear, so only their cycle contrast is used
articulation_vertices and bridges are near-collinear, so only articulation_vertices is used

dependency_contract.holdout: For each fold, hold out that complete batch set simultaneously in both orientations and both sizes.
dependency_contract.nuisance_fit: One joint model across all four size-orientation environments, with four unpenalized environment intercepts and common feature slopes.
dependency_contract.uncertainty: Conditional-on-fitted-fold-model batch score dispersion. The two orientations remain coupled inside each size-batch vector; size blocks are reported separately and are not meta-analysed into independent evidence.
dependency_contract.uncertainty_boundary: The nuisance models share slopes across sizes and are not refit inside a batch bootstrap or delete-one loop. Stored cross-size covariance blocks are zero only conditional on the fitted fold models. The reported dispersions and normal reference ranges are not full sampling SEs or confidence intervals and cannot support significance claims.

dispersion_boundary: Reported batch quantities are held-out score dispersions conditional on the fitted fold models. The nuisance models share slopes across sizes and were not refit in a cluster bootstrap or delete-one loop, so these are not full sampling standard errors or confidence intervals. Stored cross-size covariance blocks are zero only under that conditional view. No clone, orientation, or size is counted as an independent study, and no all-size significance claim or meta-estimate is formed.
metric_identity: With one shared prediction for both binary clones, pair-average Brier loss minus the residual cross-product equals mean[(y1+y2)/2-y1*y2], which is model-invariant. Therefore Brier gain equals absorbed dependence algebraically and is an audit, not independent corroboration. Log-loss gain is the separate held-out loss diagnostic.

N325.comparison_boundary: The parent uses full-sample clone-specific means and GLS direction weights; the reanalysis uses fold-held symmetry-locked means and equal direction weights.

N425.comparison_boundary: The parent uses full-sample clone-specific means and GLS direction weights; the reanalysis uses fold-held symmetry-locked means and equal direction weights.

safe_filter_semantics: orientation-specific branch_common_safe==1; paired orientations share batch/replica streams but need not both be at risk or common-safe
